---
title: "Comparison of Qualitative, Quantitative, and Machine Learning ctDNA Response Classification Approaches"
author: "Statistical Analysis"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

## Introduction

This analysis compares three approaches for classifying circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) response patterns and their association with overall survival (OS):

1. **Qualitative Approach**: Binary classification based on ctDNA status changes (Clearance, Conversion, Persistent Positive [most recent value positive], Persistent Negative [most recent value negative])
2. **Quantitative Approach**: Classification based on percent change from most recent ctDNA assessment (Major Response ≥90% reduction, Partial Response 30-89% reduction, Progressive ≥20% increase, Stable (0-29% change), Persistent Negative [most recent value negative])
3. **Machine Learning Approach**: Unsupervised clustering using multiple ctDNA kinetic features

Performance is evaluated using Harrell's C-index (concordance index) and Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) from Cox proportional hazards models, with pairwise comparisons using bootstrap-based p-values. **A landmark analysis at 6 months is used to reduce immortal time bias** by only including patients who survived at least 6 months and analyzing survival from the 6-month landmark timepoint forward.

## Methods

### Study Population and Eligibility Criteria

Eligible patients for this analysis included individuals diagnosed with bladder cancer (urothelial carcinoma of the bladder, upper tract urothelial carcinoma [UTUC], or variant histology) who had:

- A baseline ctDNA measurement (first ctDNA measurement date used as time anchor)
- At least one follow-up ctDNA measurement
- Survived at least 6 months from their time anchor (baseline ctDNA date, or survival/follow-up date if baseline ctDNA date was unavailable) - this requirement was applied to mitigate immortal time bias in the landmark analysis
- Valid ctDNA classifications for all three approaches (Qualitative, Quantitative, and ML) for the comparative analysis

Patients who died within 6 months of their time anchor were excluded from the analysis.

The analytic cohort was derived from a larger dataset of patients with diverse bladder cancer disease states, histologies, and treatment settings. Patients were excluded from the comparative analysis if they lacked sufficient ctDNA data to generate valid classifications for any of the three approaches.

### ctDNA Classification Approaches

#### Qualitative Approach

The qualitative approach uses binary classification based on ctDNA status changes:

- **ctDNA Clearance**: Baseline was positive (detectable), became negative (undetectable) at any point after baseline
- **ctDNA Conversion**: Most recent test is positive (detectable) with the previous test being negative (undetectable)
- **Persistent Positive**: Most recent value is positive (remained positive from most recent assessment)
- **Persistent Negative**: Most recent value is negative (remained negative from most recent assessment)

#### Quantitative Approach

The quantitative approach classifies patients based on percent change from the most recent ctDNA assessment to the previous measurement:

- **Major Response (≥90% reduction)**: ≥90% reduction from most recent assessment (baseline must be > 0)
- **Partial Response (30-89% reduction)**: 30-89% reduction from most recent assessment (baseline must be > 0)
- **Progressive (≥20% increase)**: ≥20% increase from most recent assessment, or de novo ctDNA detection (baseline = 0, became > 0)
- **Stable (0-29% change)**: 0-29% reduction or 0-29% increase from most recent assessment (baseline must be > 0)
- **Persistent Negative**: All measurements are 0 (undetectable ctDNA throughout)

#### Machine Learning Approach

The machine learning approach uses unsupervised k-means clustering (k=5) on multiple ctDNA kinetic features extracted from longitudinal ctDNA measurements:

- Baseline ctDNA value
- Number of measurements
- Mean, median, maximum, and minimum ctDNA values
- Standard deviation and coefficient of variation
- Number of positive and negative measurements
- Clearance and conversion patterns (binary indicators)
- Linear trend over time
- Percent change from baseline
- Time span of ctDNA monitoring

All features were standardized (z-scored) prior to clustering. Patients were assigned to one of five clusters based on their ctDNA kinetic profile.

### Overall Survival Endpoint

Overall survival (OS) was defined as the time from a prespecified 6-month landmark to death from any cause.

**Time Anchor**: The time anchor for survival calculation was defined as the baseline ctDNA measurement date (first ctDNA measurement for each patient). If the baseline ctDNA date was not available, the survival/follow-up date was used as the time anchor.

**Landmark Analysis Requirement**: To mitigate immortal time bias, only patients who survived at least 6 months from their time anchor (baseline ctDNA date or survival date) were included in the analysis. Specifically:

- OS time was calculated from the time anchor to death (for deceased patients) or last known follow-up (for censored patients)
- Patients with OS time < 6 months were excluded from the analysis
- For included patients, survival time was then adjusted to start from the 6-month landmark: `os_time_landmark = os_time - 6 months`
- Survival analysis was performed from the 6-month landmark timepoint forward
- Patients who died within 6 months of their time anchor were excluded from the analysis

**Censoring**: Censoring occurred at the last known follow-up date for patients who were still alive at the time of analysis.

### Statistical Analysis

#### Primary Endpoint: Comparative Discriminatory Performance

The primary endpoint was the comparative discriminatory performance for overall survival, quantified using Harrell's C-index (concordance index). The C-index ranges from 0.5 (random prediction) to 1.0 (perfect prediction), with higher values indicating better discriminatory performance.

For each classification approach, a Cox proportional hazards model was fitted with the ctDNA response groups as the predictor variable and OS (from 6-month landmark) as the outcome. C-indices were calculated with 95% confidence intervals using bootstrap resampling (n=500 bootstrap samples).

#### Model Comparison

Pairwise comparisons of C-indices between approaches were performed using bootstrap-based hypothesis testing. For each pair of models, the difference in C-index was calculated, and a two-sided p-value was obtained by comparing the observed difference to the distribution of differences from 500 bootstrap samples. The null hypothesis was that the C-index difference equals zero.

#### Secondary Analyses

- **Akaike Information Criterion (AIC)**: Used to compare model simplicity and goodness-of-fit, with lower AIC values indicating better model fit adjusted for complexity
- **Hazard Ratios**: Calculated from Cox models to provide contextual interpretation of effect sizes, with the group with the best prognosis (lowest event rate) used as the reference

#### Sensitivity Analyses

Sensitivity analyses were performed to assess whether model performance differed across patient subgroups:

1. **By Therapy Type**: Stratified analyses were conducted for patients receiving:
   - Neoadjuvant therapy
   - Adjuvant therapy
   - Palliative therapy
   - No systemic therapy

   Patients could be counted in multiple therapy categories if they received multiple types of therapy during their ctDNA monitoring period.

2. **By Histology Type**: Stratified analyses were conducted for:
   - Urothelial carcinoma of the bladder
   - UTUC or variant histology

   Classification was based on primary tumor location (bladder vs. upper tract) combined with histology type.

For each subgroup, C-indices and pairwise comparisons were calculated using the same methods as the primary analysis.

#### Statistical Software

All analyses were performed using R (version 4.x or higher) with the following packages: `survival`, `survminer`, `dplyr`, `tidyr`, `ggplot2`, and `kableExtra`. Bootstrap resampling was performed with a fixed random seed (seed=123) for reproducibility.

```{r extract_survival_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Extract Survival Data
# ==============================

# Function to extract survival data from a dataset
extract_survival_data <- function(dat, id_col_name) {
  # Get relapse date
  relapse_date <- NULL
  relapse_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date|progression.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(relapse_cols) > 0) {
    relapse_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(relapse_date_raw = all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(relapse_date = as_date_safe(relapse_date_raw)) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), relapse_date)
    relapse_date <- relapse_data
  }
  
  # Get explicit death date
  explicit_death_date <- NULL
  death_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                 !str_detect(names(dat), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
    death_date_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(death_date_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(death_date_raw = all_of(death_date_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        explicit_death_date = if (inherits(death_date_raw, "Date")) {
          death_date_raw
        } else {
          as_date_safe(death_date_raw)
        }
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), explicit_death_date)
    explicit_death_date <- death_date_data
  }
  
  # Get survival/follow-up date
  survival_date <- NULL
  survival_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                              !str_detect(names(dat), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
    survival_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(survival_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(survival_date_raw = all_of(survival_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(survival_date = as_date_safe(survival_date_raw)) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), survival_date)
    survival_date <- survival_data
  }
  
  # Get alive yes/no status
  alive_status <- NULL
  alive_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
    alive_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(alive_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(alive_status_raw = all_of(alive_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        alive_yes_no = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(alive_status_raw)), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(alive_status_raw)), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), alive_yes_no)
    alive_status <- alive_data
  }
  
  # Get death status (legacy)
  death_status <- NULL
  death_status_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("death|died|vital.*status", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                   !str_detect(names(dat), regex("date|alive", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(death_status_cols) > 0) {
    death_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(death_status_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(death_status_raw = all_of(death_status_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        death_status_legacy = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(death_status_raw)), "yes|dead|died|death|deceased") ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0
        )
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), death_status_legacy)
    death_status <- death_data
  }
  
  # Extract palliative therapy start dates
  palliative_dates <- NULL
  therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  therapy_start_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*start.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  if (length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0 && length(therapy_start_cols) > 0) {
    therapy_settings_long <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "setting") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
        setting_lower = tolower(as.character(setting))
      ) %>%
      filter(str_detect(setting_lower, "palliative"))
    
    therapy_starts_long <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
        start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(start_date))
    
    palliative_dates <- therapy_settings_long %>%
      left_join(therapy_starts_long, by = c(id_col_name, "therapy_idx")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
      group_by(.data[[id_col_name]]) %>%
      summarise(
        first_palliative_date = min(start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      rename(palliative_start_date = first_palliative_date)
  }
  
  # Combine
  result <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col_name))
  if (!is.null(relapse_date)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(relapse_date, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(relapse_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  if (!is.null(explicit_death_date)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(explicit_death_date, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(explicit_death_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  if (!is.null(survival_date)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(survival_date, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(survival_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  if (!is.null(alive_status)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(alive_status, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(alive_yes_no = NA_character_)
  }
  if (!is.null(death_status)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(death_status, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(death_status_legacy = NA_real_)
  }
  if (!is.null(palliative_dates)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(palliative_dates, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(palliative_start_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  
  result
}

# Extract survival data
survival_data <- extract_survival_data(dat_combined, "patient_id")
```

```{r create_survival_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Create Survival Outcomes
# ==============================

# Get baseline ctDNA
baseline_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(ctdna_date) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, baseline_date = ctdna_date, baseline_value = ctdna_value)

# Get last ctDNA dates
last_ctdna_dates <- ctdna_long %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Extract last therapy dates
extract_last_therapy_date <- function(dat, id_col_name) {
  therapy_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*(start|end).*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(therapy_cols) > 0) {
    therapy_dates_long <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "therapy_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(therapy_date = as_date_safe(therapy_date_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_date)) %>%
      group_by(.data[[id_col_name]]) %>%
      summarise(last_therapy_date = max(therapy_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    return(therapy_dates_long)
  } else {
    return(tibble(!!id_col_name := dat[[id_col_name]], last_therapy_date = as.Date(NA)))
  }
}

last_therapy_dates <- extract_last_therapy_date(dat_combined, "patient_id")

# Create survival outcomes
all_patients <- dat_combined %>%
  select(patient_id) %>%
  distinct()

survival_outcomes <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(baseline_ctdna, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(last_ctdna_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(last_therapy_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(survival_data, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(
    time_anchor = coalesce(baseline_date, survival_date),
    relapse_date_combined = case_when(
      !is.na(relapse_date) & !is.na(palliative_start_date) ~ pmin(relapse_date, palliative_start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      !is.na(relapse_date) ~ relapse_date,
      !is.na(palliative_start_date) ~ palliative_start_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    death_status_final = case_when(
      !is.na(explicit_death_date) ~ 1,
      alive_yes_no == "No" ~ 1,
      !is.na(death_status_legacy) & death_status_legacy == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    death_date = case_when(
      !is.na(explicit_death_date) ~ explicit_death_date,
      alive_yes_no == "No" & !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,
      alive_yes_no == "No" & !is.na(relapse_date_combined) ~ relapse_date_combined,
      death_status_legacy == 1 & !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    max_ctdna_therapy_date = {
      result <- rep(as.Date(NA), nrow(.))
      for (i in 1:nrow(.)) {
        if (!is.na(last_ctdna_date[i]) && !is.na(last_therapy_date[i])) {
          result[i] <- pmax(last_ctdna_date[i], last_therapy_date[i])
        } else if (!is.na(last_ctdna_date[i])) {
          result[i] <- last_ctdna_date[i]
        } else if (!is.na(last_therapy_date[i])) {
          result[i] <- last_therapy_date[i]
        }
      }
      result
    },
    last_available_date = case_when(
      !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,
      !is.na(max_ctdna_therapy_date) ~ max_ctdna_therapy_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_to_relapse = ifelse(!is.na(relapse_date_combined) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                            as.numeric(relapse_date_combined - time_anchor) / 30.44, NA_real_),
    time_to_death = ifelse(!is.na(death_date) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                          as.numeric(death_date - time_anchor) / 30.44, NA_real_),
    time_to_last_fu = ifelse(!is.na(last_available_date) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                             as.numeric(last_available_date - time_anchor) / 30.44, NA_real_),
    relapse_event = ifelse(!is.na(relapse_date_combined), 1, 0),
    death_event = death_status_final,
    pfs_time = ifelse(relapse_event == 1 & !is.na(time_to_relapse), time_to_relapse, 
                     ifelse(!is.na(time_to_last_fu), time_to_last_fu, NA_real_)),
    os_time = ifelse(
      death_event == 1 & !is.na(time_to_death), 
      time_to_death,
      ifelse(!is.na(time_to_last_fu), time_to_last_fu, NA_real_)
    )
  )

# Create landmark analysis version (6 months) to reduce immortal time bias
landmark_time_months <- 6

survival_outcomes_landmark <- survival_outcomes %>%
  filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time >= landmark_time_months) %>%
  mutate(
    # Adjust survival time to start from landmark
    os_time_landmark = os_time - landmark_time_months,
    # Keep the same death event (patients who died before landmark are already excluded)
    death_event_landmark = death_event
  ) %>%
  filter(os_time_landmark > 0)  # Ensure positive survival time after landmark
```

```{r descriptive_statistics, echo=FALSE}
# Calculate descriptive statistics for landmark population

  desc_stats <- survival_outcomes_landmark %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Events = sum(death_event_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      Censored = sum(death_event_landmark == 0, na.rm = TRUE),

      Mean_OS_Landmark = mean(os_time_landmark, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"

  cat("**Descriptive Statistics (Post-Landmark):**\n\n")
  desc_table <- tibble(
    Statistic = c("Total N", "Events", "Censored", "Median OS (months)", "Mean OS (months)", "OS Range (months)"),
    Value = c(
      desc_stats$N,
      desc_stats$Events,
      desc_stats$Censored,
      round(desc_stats$Median_OS_Landmark, 1),
      round(desc_stats$Mean_OS_Landmark, 1),
      paste0(round(desc_stats$Min_OS_Landmark, 1), "-", round(desc_stats$Max_OS_Landmark, 1))
    )
  )
  
  desc_table %>%
    kable(caption = "Descriptive Statistics for Evaluable Population (6-Month Landmark)", align = "c") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
  
  cat("\n")
}

# Note: The evaluable sample size for model comparison will be calculated after ctDNA groups are created
# It will be smaller than the landmark population because only patients with valid classifications
# for all three models (Qualitative, Quantitative, and ML) are included
cat("**Note:** The evaluable sample size for model comparison (shown below) may be smaller than the landmark population (", 
    patients_after_landmark, ") because only patients with valid ctDNA classifications for all three models ",
    "(Qualitative, Quantitative, and ML) are included in the comparative analysis. ",
    "This ensures fair comparison across all three approaches using the same patient population.\n\n")
cat("**Model-specific sample sizes will be shown in the performance comparison table.**\n\n")
```

```{r create_qualitative_quantitative_groups, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Create Qualitative and Quantitative Groups
# ==============================

# Qualitative groups
# Definitions:
# - ctDNA Clearance: Baseline was positive (detectable), became negative (undetectable) at any point after baseline
# - ctDNA Conversion: Most recent test is positive (detectable) with the previous test being negative (undetectable)
# - Persistent Positive: Most recent value is positive (remained positive from most recent assessment)
# - Persistent Negative: Most recent value is negative (remained negative from most recent assessment)

qualitative_groups <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(
    ctdna_long %>%
      left_join(baseline_ctdna, by = "patient_id") %>%
      filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
      arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      mutate(
        baseline_value = first(baseline_value),
        baseline_date = first(baseline_date),
        days_from_baseline = as.numeric(ctdna_date - baseline_date),
        is_after_baseline = days_from_baseline > 0,
        row_num = row_number(),
        n_rows = n()
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        baseline_status = ifelse(first(baseline_value) > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
        became_negative_after = any(is_after_baseline & baseline_value > 0 & ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        last_status = ifelse(last(ctdna_value) > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
        last_value = last(ctdna_value),
        # Get the second-to-last value (if there are at least 2 measurements)
        second_to_last_value = ifelse(n() >= 2, nth(ctdna_value, n() - 1), NA_real_),
        # Conversion: most recent is positive, previous (second to last) was negative
        conversion_recent = n() >= 2 & !is.na(last_value) & !is.na(second_to_last_value) & last_value > 0 & second_to_last_value == 0,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        qualitative_group = case_when(
          baseline_status == "Positive" & became_negative_after ~ "ctDNA Clearance",
          # ctDNA Conversion: Most recent test positive, previous test negative
          conversion_recent ~ "ctDNA Conversion",
          # Persistent Positive: Most recent value is positive (and not conversion or clearance)
          last_status == "Positive" & !conversion_recent & !(baseline_status == "Positive" & became_negative_after) ~ "Persistent Positive",
          # Persistent Negative: Most recent value is negative (and not conversion)
          last_status == "Negative" & !conversion_recent ~ "Persistent Negative",
          TRUE ~ "No ctDNA Data"
        )
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, qualitative_group),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(qualitative_group = ifelse(is.na(qualitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", qualitative_group))

# Quantitative groups using new criteria
# Definitions:
# - ctDNA Complete Response (CCR): ctDNA clearance after initial detectability (baseline > 0, became 0)
# - ctDNA Partial Response (CPR): Decrease of >10% from baseline
# - ctDNA Stable Disease (CSD): No increase or up to 10% increase or decrease (change between -10% and +10%)
# - ctDNA Progressive Disease (CPD): Increase of >10% or de novo ctDNA detection (baseline 0, became > 0)
# - ctDNA Nonmeasurable Disease (CND): Undetectable ctDNA before and after treatment (baseline 0, remained 0)

# Quantitative groups based on percent change from most recent ctDNA assessment
# For each patient, calculate percent change from most recent measurement to previous measurement
quantitative_groups <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(
    ctdna_long %>%
      left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_date, baseline_value), by = "patient_id") %>%
      filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
      arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      mutate(
        prev_value = lag(ctdna_value),
        prev_date = lag(ctdna_date),
        days_from_prev = as.numeric(ctdna_date - prev_date),
        # Calculate percent change from most recent assessment
        percent_change_from_recent = case_when(
          prev_value == 0 & ctdna_value > 0 ~ 100,  # New positive
          prev_value == 0 & ctdna_value == 0 ~ 0,   # Persistent negative
          prev_value > 0 ~ ((ctdna_value - prev_value) / prev_value) * 100,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
      ) %>%
      # Get the most recent percent change (last non-NA value)
      filter(!is.na(percent_change_from_recent)) %>%
      summarise(
        baseline_value = first(baseline_value),
        most_recent_pct_change = last(percent_change_from_recent),
        most_recent_value = last(ctdna_value),
        prev_value_for_recent = last(prev_value),
        all_zero = all(ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        ever_positive = any(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        quantitative_group = case_when(
          # Persistent Negative: All measurements are 0
          all_zero ~ "Persistent Negative",
          # For patients who started negative (baseline = 0) and became positive: classify as Progressive
          baseline_value == 0 & ever_positive & !is.na(most_recent_value) & most_recent_value > 0 ~ "Progressive (≥20% increase)",
          # Major Response: ≥90% reduction from most recent (baseline must be > 0)
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(most_recent_pct_change) & most_recent_pct_change <= -90 ~ "Major Response (≥90% reduction)",
          # Partial Response: 30-89% reduction from most recent (baseline must be > 0)
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(most_recent_pct_change) & most_recent_pct_change <= -30 & most_recent_pct_change > -90 ~ "Partial Response (30-89% reduction)",
          # Progressive: ≥20% increase from most recent (baseline must be > 0)
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(most_recent_pct_change) & most_recent_pct_change >= 20 ~ "Progressive (≥20% increase)",
          # Stable: 0-29% reduction or 0-29% increase (baseline must be > 0)
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(most_recent_pct_change) & most_recent_pct_change > -30 & most_recent_pct_change < 20 ~ "Stable (0-29% change)",
          # Fallback for cases with baseline but no follow-up comparisons
          baseline_value == 0 & !ever_positive ~ "Persistent Negative",
          TRUE ~ "No ctDNA Data"
        )
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, quantitative_group),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(quantitative_group = ifelse(is.na(quantitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", quantitative_group))

# Create ML groups
ctdna_with_trend <- ctdna_long %>%
  left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_value, baseline_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(
    time_from_first = as.numeric(ctdna_date - min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
    row_num = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

calculate_trend <- function(values, times) {
  valid <- !is.na(values) & !is.na(times)
  if (sum(valid) > 1) {
    tryCatch({
      lm_fit <- lm(values[valid] ~ times[valid])
      as.numeric(coef(lm_fit)[2])
    }, error = function(e) 0)
  } else {
    0
  }
}

trend_data <- ctdna_with_trend %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 1, sum(!is.na(ctdna_value)) > 1, sum(!is.na(time_from_first)) > 1) %>%
  summarise(trend = calculate_trend(ctdna_value, time_from_first), .groups = "drop")

patients_no_trend <- ctdna_with_trend %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n == 1 | !patient_id %in% trend_data$patient_id) %>%
  mutate(trend = 0) %>%
  select(patient_id, trend)

trend_all <- bind_rows(trend_data, patients_no_trend)

ml_features <- ctdna_with_trend %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_value = first(baseline_value),
    n_measurements = n(),
    mean_ctdna = mean(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ctdna = median(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ctdna = max(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ctdna = min(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ctdna = sd(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_positive = sum(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_negative = sum(ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    became_negative = any(baseline_value > 0 & ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    became_positive = any(baseline_value == 0 & ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_value = last(ctdna_value),
    first_value = first(ctdna_value),
    pct_change_baseline = ifelse(baseline_value > 0, 
                                 ((last(ctdna_value) - baseline_value) / baseline_value) * 100,
                                 ifelse(baseline_value == 0 & last(ctdna_value) > 0, 100, 0)),
    time_span_days = as.numeric(max(ctdna_date) - min(ctdna_date)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(trend_all, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(
    cv_ctdna = ifelse(mean_ctdna > 0 & !is.na(sd_ctdna), sd_ctdna / mean_ctdna, 0),
    trend_per_day = ifelse(!is.na(time_span_days) & time_span_days > 0, trend / time_span_days, 0),
    clearance_pattern = became_negative & baseline_value > 0,
    conversion_pattern = became_positive & baseline_value == 0,
    persistent_positive = baseline_value > 0 & !became_negative & last_value > 0,
    persistent_negative = baseline_value == 0 & !became_positive & last_value == 0,
    across(c(mean_ctdna, median_ctdna, max_ctdna, min_ctdna, sd_ctdna, trend, cv_ctdna, 
             trend_per_day, pct_change_baseline, time_span_days),
           ~ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .))
  )

# Use all available data for clustering to improve generalizability
# For unsupervised learning (k-means), using all data is appropriate and helps
# identify more stable, generalizable cluster patterns
set.seed(123)

# Select features for clustering
feature_cols <- setdiff(names(ml_features), c("patient_id", "baseline_value"))
ml_features_for_clustering <- ml_features %>%
  select(all_of(feature_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~{
    x <- .
    x[is.infinite(x)] <- 0
    x[is.nan(x)] <- 0
    x
  }))

# Scale all features using all data
ml_features_scaled <- scale(ml_features_for_clustering)
ml_features_scaled[is.infinite(ml_features_scaled)] <- 0
ml_features_scaled[is.nan(ml_features_scaled)] <- 0

# Use 5 clusters for clustering
n_clusters <- 5

# Perform k-means clustering on all data
kmeans_result <- kmeans(ml_features_scaled, centers = n_clusters, nstart = 50, iter.max = 200)

# Extract cluster assignments for all patients
cluster_characteristics <- ml_features %>%
  mutate(ml_cluster = kmeans_result$cluster) %>%
  group_by(ml_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_baseline = mean(baseline_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_trend = mean(trend, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_clearance = mean(clearance_pattern, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_conversion = mean(conversion_pattern, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_persistent_pos = mean(persistent_positive, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_persistent_neg = mean(persistent_negative, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_baseline, mean_trend)

# Use cluster numbers for ML groups (unsupervised clustering)
cluster_names <- cluster_characteristics %>%
  mutate(
    group_name = paste0("Cluster ", ml_cluster)
  ) %>%
  select(ml_cluster, group_name)

# Assign cluster labels to all patients
ml_groups <- ml_features %>%
  mutate(ml_cluster = kmeans_result$cluster) %>%
  left_join(cluster_names, by = "ml_cluster") %>%
  select(patient_id, ml_group = group_name, ml_cluster)
```

```{r create_cindex_aic_table, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Create C-Index and AIC Comparison Table
# ==============================

# Function to calculate C-index with 95% CI using bootstrap
calculate_c_index_with_ci <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var, n_bootstrap = 500) {
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_clean) == 0 || sum(data_clean[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(list(c_index = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_, aic = NA_real_, n = 0))
  }
  
  surv_formula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var))
  cox_fit <- tryCatch({
    coxph(surv_formula, data = data_clean)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(cox_fit)) {
    return(list(c_index = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_, aic = NA_real_, n = nrow(data_clean)))
  }
  
  c_index <- tryCatch({
    summary(cox_fit)$concordance[1]
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_
  })
  
  aic_value <- tryCatch({
    AIC(cox_fit)
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_
  })
  
  # Bootstrap for 95% CI
  set.seed(123)
  n <- nrow(data_clean)
  c_index_bootstrap <- numeric(n_bootstrap)
  
  for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
    boot_idx <- sample(1:n, size = n, replace = TRUE)
    data_boot <- data_clean[boot_idx, ]
    
    cox_fit_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula, data = data_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_fit_boot)) {
      c_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
      if (!is.na(c_boot)) {
        c_index_bootstrap[i] <- c_boot
      }
    }
  }
  
  ci_lower <- quantile(c_index_bootstrap[c_index_bootstrap > 0], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  ci_upper <- quantile(c_index_bootstrap[c_index_bootstrap > 0], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (is.na(ci_lower)) ci_lower <- NA_real_
  if (is.na(ci_upper)) ci_upper <- NA_real_
  
  return(list(c_index = c_index, ci_lower = ci_lower, ci_upper = ci_upper, aic = aic_value, n = nrow(data_clean)))
}

# Function to compare C-indices between two models using bootstrap
compare_c_indices <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var1, group_var2, n_bootstrap = 500) {
  data_clean1 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var1]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var1]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  data_clean2 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var2]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var2]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  common_patients <- intersect(data_clean1$patient_id, data_clean2$patient_id)
  
  if (length(common_patients) < 10) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, diff_ci_lower = NA_real_, diff_ci_upper = NA_real_, n_common = length(common_patients)))
  }
  
  data_common <- data %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% common_patients) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0,
           !is.na(.data[[group_var1]]), !is.na(.data[[group_var2]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var1]]), "no ctdna data"),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var2]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_common) == 0 || sum(data_common[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, diff_ci_lower = NA_real_, diff_ci_upper = NA_real_, n_common = 0))
  }
  
  surv_formula1 <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var1))
  surv_formula2 <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var2))
  
  cox_fit1 <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula1, data = data_common), error = function(e) NULL)
  cox_fit2 <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula2, data = data_common), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(cox_fit1) || is.null(cox_fit2)) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, diff_ci_lower = NA_real_, diff_ci_upper = NA_real_, n_common = nrow(data_common)))
  }
  
  c_index1 <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit1)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
  c_index2 <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit2)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  if (is.na(c_index1) || is.na(c_index2)) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, diff_ci_lower = NA_real_, diff_ci_upper = NA_real_, n_common = nrow(data_common)))
  }
  
  diff_observed <- c_index1 - c_index2
  
  # Bootstrap to get p-value and CI
  set.seed(123)
  n <- nrow(data_common)
  diff_bootstrap <- numeric(n_bootstrap)
  
  for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
    boot_idx <- sample(1:n, size = n, replace = TRUE)
    data_boot <- data_common[boot_idx, ]
    
    cox_fit1_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula1, data = data_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
    cox_fit2_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula2, data = data_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_fit1_boot) && !is.null(cox_fit2_boot)) {
      c1_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit1_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
      c2_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit2_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
      
      if (!is.na(c1_boot) && !is.na(c2_boot)) {
        diff_bootstrap[i] <- c1_boot - c2_boot
      }
    }
  }
  
  p_value <- mean(abs(diff_bootstrap) >= abs(diff_observed), na.rm = TRUE)
  diff_ci_lower <- quantile(diff_bootstrap[diff_bootstrap != 0], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  diff_ci_upper <- quantile(diff_bootstrap[diff_bootstrap != 0], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (is.na(diff_ci_lower)) diff_ci_lower <- NA_real_
  if (is.na(diff_ci_upper)) diff_ci_upper <- NA_real_
  
  return(list(
    p_value = p_value,
    diff_c_index = diff_observed,
    diff_ci_lower = diff_ci_lower,
    diff_ci_upper = diff_ci_upper,
    c_index1 = c_index1,
    c_index2 = c_index2,
    n_common = nrow(data_common),
    n_bootstrap = sum(!is.na(diff_bootstrap))
  ))
}

# Merge survival with groups (using landmark analysis to reduce immortal time bias)
# Ensure all models use the same patient pool - only patients with data in all three models
common_patients_all_models <- survival_outcomes_landmark$patient_id %>%
  intersect(qualitative_groups$patient_id[qualitative_groups$qualitative_group != "No ctDNA Data"]) %>%
  intersect(quantitative_groups$patient_id[quantitative_groups$quantitative_group != "No ctDNA Data"]) %>%
  intersect(ml_groups$patient_id[!is.na(ml_groups$ml_group)])

# All three models use the same patient pool
# Since we're using common_patients_all_models, all patients should have valid classifications
# No need to set "No ctDNA Data" - if missing, it's an error
survival_qualitative <- survival_outcomes_landmark %>%
  filter(patient_id %in% common_patients_all_models) %>%
  inner_join(qualitative_groups %>% select(patient_id, qualitative_group), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(qualitative_group != "No ctDNA Data")

survival_quantitative <- survival_outcomes_landmark %>%
  filter(patient_id %in% common_patients_all_models) %>%
  inner_join(quantitative_groups %>% select(patient_id, quantitative_group), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(quantitative_group != "No ctDNA Data")

survival_ml <- survival_outcomes_landmark %>%
  filter(patient_id %in% common_patients_all_models) %>%
  inner_join(ml_groups %>% select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ml_group))

# Calculate C-index and AIC for all three approaches (OS only, using landmark analysis)
qual_os_results <- calculate_c_index_with_ci(survival_qualitative, "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", "qualitative_group")
quant_os_results <- calculate_c_index_with_ci(survival_quantitative, "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", "quantitative_group")
ml_os_results <- calculate_c_index_with_ci(survival_ml, "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", "ml_group")

# Compare Quantitative vs Qualitative and ML
comp_quant_vs_qual <- compare_c_indices(
  survival_quantitative %>% 
    left_join(survival_qualitative %>% select(patient_id, qualitative_group), by = "patient_id"),
  "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", 
  "quantitative_group", "qualitative_group"
)

comp_quant_vs_ml <- compare_c_indices(
  survival_quantitative %>% 
    left_join(survival_ml %>% select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id"),
  "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", 
  "quantitative_group", "ml_group"
)

comp_qual_vs_ml <- compare_c_indices(
  survival_qualitative %>% 
    left_join(survival_ml %>% select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id"),
  "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", 
  "qualitative_group", "ml_group"
)
```

```{r categorize_therapy_types, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Categorize Patients by Therapy Type
# ==============================

# Function to clean therapy setting (same as in ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd)
clean_setting <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    y %in% c("neo","neoadjuvant","neoadjuvant therapy","neoadjuvant systemic therapy") ~ "Neoadjuvant",
    y %in% c("adjuvant","adjuvant therapy","adjuvant systemic therapy") ~ "Adjuvant",
    y %in% c("palliative","metastatic","1l metastatic","2l metastatic") ~ "Palliative",
    y %in% c("","na","n/a","unknown","other","other (see notes)") ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ str_to_title(y)
  )
}

# Extract systemic therapy settings
# Start with all patients in common_patients_all_models to ensure we include everyone
patient_therapy_base <- tibble(patient_id = common_patients_all_models) %>%
  mutate(
    has_neoadjuvant = FALSE,
    has_adjuvant = FALSE,
    has_palliative = FALSE
  )

therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*treatment.*setting|systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0) {
  therapy_settings_long <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, all_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
      setting_clean = clean_setting(setting_raw)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(setting_clean))
  
  # Summarize per patient - patients can have multiple therapy types
  patient_therapy_with_data <- therapy_settings_long %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(
      has_neoadjuvant = any(setting_clean == "Neoadjuvant", na.rm = TRUE),
      has_adjuvant = any(setting_clean == "Adjuvant", na.rm = TRUE),
      has_palliative = any(setting_clean == "Palliative", na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Merge with base to ensure all patients are included
  patient_therapy <- patient_therapy_base %>%
    left_join(patient_therapy_with_data, by = "patient_id", suffix = c("", "_new")) %>%
    mutate(
      has_neoadjuvant = ifelse(!is.na(has_neoadjuvant_new), has_neoadjuvant_new, has_neoadjuvant),
      has_adjuvant = ifelse(!is.na(has_adjuvant_new), has_adjuvant_new, has_adjuvant),
      has_palliative = ifelse(!is.na(has_palliative_new), has_palliative_new, has_palliative)
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, has_neoadjuvant, has_adjuvant, has_palliative)
} else {
  patient_therapy <- patient_therapy_base
}

# Determine if patient received any systemic therapy
patient_therapy <- patient_therapy %>%
  mutate(
    has_any_systemic = has_neoadjuvant | has_adjuvant | has_palliative,
    therapy_category = case_when(
      has_palliative ~ "Palliative",
      has_adjuvant ~ "Adjuvant",
      has_neoadjuvant ~ "Neoadjuvant",
      !has_any_systemic ~ "No Systemic Therapy",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Create therapy groups for table (patients can be in multiple groups)
# Ensure all common_patients_all_models are included
therapy_groups_table <- patient_therapy %>%
  # Ensure we have all patients
  filter(patient_id %in% common_patients_all_models) %>%
  select(patient_id, has_neoadjuvant, has_adjuvant, has_palliative, has_any_systemic) %>%
  mutate(
    Neoadjuvant = ifelse(has_neoadjuvant, "Yes", "No"),
    Adjuvant = ifelse(has_adjuvant, "Yes", "No"),
    Palliative = ifelse(has_palliative, "Yes", "No"),
    `No Systemic Therapy` = ifelse(!has_any_systemic, "Yes", "No")
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, Neoadjuvant, Adjuvant, Palliative, `No Systemic Therapy`)

# Merge therapy information with survival data for sensitivity analyses
survival_qualitative_therapy <- survival_qualitative %>%
  left_join(patient_therapy %>% select(patient_id, has_neoadjuvant, has_adjuvant, has_palliative, has_any_systemic, therapy_category), by = "patient_id")

survival_quantitative_therapy <- survival_quantitative %>%
  left_join(patient_therapy %>% select(patient_id, has_neoadjuvant, has_adjuvant, has_palliative, has_any_systemic, therapy_category), by = "patient_id")

survival_ml_therapy <- survival_ml %>%
  left_join(patient_therapy %>% select(patient_id, has_neoadjuvant, has_adjuvant, has_palliative, has_any_systemic, therapy_category), by = "patient_id")
```

```{r therapy_type_table, echo=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Table: Patient Counts by Therapy Type
# ==============================

cat("## Patient Distribution by Therapy Type\n\n")
cat("**Note:** Patients can be counted in multiple therapy categories if they received multiple types of therapy during their ctDNA monitoring period.\n\n")

# Create table with patient counts by therapy type
# Use therapy_groups_table which already includes all common_patients_all_models
total_n <- length(common_patients_all_models)

therapy_table <- tibble(
  `Therapy Type` = c("Neoadjuvant", "Adjuvant", "Palliative", "No Systemic Therapy"),
  N = c(
    sum(therapy_groups_table$Neoadjuvant == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(therapy_groups_table$Adjuvant == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(therapy_groups_table$Palliative == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(therapy_groups_table$`No Systemic Therapy` == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = total_n,
    `%` = round(N / Total * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(`Therapy Type`, N, `%`)

therapy_table %>%
  kable(caption = "Table: Patient Counts by Therapy Type (Evaluable Population)", align = "c") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

cat("\n")
```

```{r sensitivity_analysis_by_therapy, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Sensitivity Analysis: C-Index by Therapy Type
# ==============================

# Function to run sensitivity analysis for a specific therapy type
run_therapy_sensitivity <- function(therapy_flag, therapy_name, survival_data_qual, survival_data_quant, survival_data_ml) {
  # Filter to patients with this therapy type
  data_qual <- survival_data_qual %>%
    filter(.data[[therapy_flag]] == TRUE)
  
  data_quant <- survival_data_quant %>%
    filter(.data[[therapy_flag]] == TRUE)
  
  data_ml <- survival_data_ml %>%
    filter(.data[[therapy_flag]] == TRUE)
  
  # Calculate C-indices
  qual_results <- calculate_c_index_with_ci(data_qual, "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", "qualitative_group")
  quant_results <- calculate_c_index_with_ci(data_quant, "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", "quantitative_group")
  ml_results <- calculate_c_index_with_ci(data_ml, "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", "ml_group")
  
  # Compare models
  comp_quant_vs_qual <- compare_c_indices(
    data_quant %>% 
      left_join(data_qual %>% select(patient_id, qualitative_group), by = "patient_id"),
    "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", 
    "quantitative_group", "qualitative_group"
  )
  
  comp_quant_vs_ml <- compare_c_indices(
    data_quant %>% 
      left_join(data_ml %>% select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id"),
    "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", 
    "quantitative_group", "ml_group"
  )
  
  comp_qual_vs_ml <- compare_c_indices(
    data_qual %>% 
      left_join(data_ml %>% select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id"),
    "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", 
    "qualitative_group", "ml_group"
  )
  
  return(list(
    therapy_name = therapy_name,
    qual_results = qual_results,
    quant_results = quant_results,
    ml_results = ml_results,
    comp_quant_vs_qual = comp_quant_vs_qual,
    comp_quant_vs_ml = comp_quant_vs_ml,
    comp_qual_vs_ml = comp_qual_vs_ml
  ))
}

# Run sensitivity analyses for each therapy type
sensitivity_neoadjuvant <- run_therapy_sensitivity(
  "has_neoadjuvant", "Neoadjuvant",
  survival_qualitative_therapy, survival_quantitative_therapy, survival_ml_therapy
)

sensitivity_adjuvant <- run_therapy_sensitivity(
  "has_adjuvant", "Adjuvant",
  survival_qualitative_therapy, survival_quantitative_therapy, survival_ml_therapy
)

sensitivity_palliative <- run_therapy_sensitivity(
  "has_palliative", "Palliative",
  survival_qualitative_therapy, survival_quantitative_therapy, survival_ml_therapy
)

# For "No Systemic Therapy", filter patients who don't have any systemic therapy
# Use coalesce to handle any potential NAs (shouldn't happen but safe)
sensitivity_no_therapy <- list(
  therapy_name = "No Systemic Therapy",
  qual_results = calculate_c_index_with_ci(
    survival_qualitative_therapy %>% filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE)),
    "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", "qualitative_group"
  ),
  quant_results = calculate_c_index_with_ci(
    survival_quantitative_therapy %>% filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE)),
    "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", "quantitative_group"
  ),
  ml_results = calculate_c_index_with_ci(
    survival_ml_therapy %>% filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE)),
    "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", "ml_group"
  )
)

# Function to compare C-indices for the same model across different therapy types
compare_model_across_therapy <- function(model_name, therapy_results_list, therapy_names, n_bootstrap = 500) {
  # Extract C-indices for this model across therapy types
  c_indices <- map_dbl(therapy_results_list, function(x) {
    if (model_name == "Qualitative") {
      if (!is.null(x$qual_results) && !is.na(x$qual_results$c_index)) {
        return(x$qual_results$c_index)
      }
    } else if (model_name == "Quantitative") {
      if (!is.null(x$quant_results) && !is.na(x$quant_results$c_index)) {
        return(x$quant_results$c_index)
      }
    } else if (model_name == "ML") {
      if (!is.null(x$ml_results) && !is.na(x$ml_results$c_index)) {
        return(x$ml_results$c_index)
      }
    }
    return(NA_real_)
  })
  
  # Get data for each therapy type
  get_therapy_data <- function(therapy_flag, survival_data) {
    if (therapy_flag == "has_any_systemic") {
      survival_data %>% filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE))
    } else {
      survival_data %>% filter(.data[[therapy_flag]] == TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  # Create comparison pairs
  n_therapies <- length(therapy_names)
  comparisons <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:(n_therapies - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n_therapies) {
      therapy1 <- therapy_names[i]
      therapy2 <- therapy_names[j]
      
      # Get therapy flags
      flag1 <- case_when(
        therapy1 == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "has_neoadjuvant",
        therapy1 == "Adjuvant" ~ "has_adjuvant",
        therapy1 == "Palliative" ~ "has_palliative",
        therapy1 == "No Systemic Therapy" ~ "has_any_systemic",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
      
      flag2 <- case_when(
        therapy2 == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "has_neoadjuvant",
        therapy2 == "Adjuvant" ~ "has_adjuvant",
        therapy2 == "Palliative" ~ "has_palliative",
        therapy2 == "No Systemic Therapy" ~ "has_any_systemic",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
      
      if (is.na(flag1) || is.na(flag2)) next
      
      # Get data for each therapy type
      if (model_name == "Qualitative") {
        data1 <- get_therapy_data(flag1, survival_qualitative_therapy)
        data2 <- get_therapy_data(flag2, survival_qualitative_therapy)
        group_var <- "qualitative_group"
      } else if (model_name == "Quantitative") {
        data1 <- get_therapy_data(flag1, survival_quantitative_therapy)
        data2 <- get_therapy_data(flag2, survival_quantitative_therapy)
        group_var <- "quantitative_group"
      } else if (model_name == "ML") {
        data1 <- get_therapy_data(flag1, survival_ml_therapy)
        data2 <- get_therapy_data(flag2, survival_ml_therapy)
        group_var <- "ml_group"
      } else {
        next
      }
      
      # Compare C-indices
      comp_result <- compare_c_indices(
        bind_rows(
          data1 %>% mutate(therapy_group = therapy1),
          data2 %>% mutate(therapy_group = therapy2)
        ) %>%
          filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), 
                 !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var]]), "no ctdna data")),
        "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark",
        group_var, group_var
      )
      
      # Actually, we need to compare the C-indices directly, not use compare_c_indices
      # Let's calculate C-index for each therapy group separately and compare
      c1 <- if (!is.na(c_indices[i])) c_indices[i] else NA_real_
      c2 <- if (!is.na(c_indices[j])) c_indices[j] else NA_real_
      
      if (is.na(c1) || is.na(c2)) {
        comparisons[[paste0(therapy1, " vs ", therapy2)]] <- list(
          therapy1 = therapy1,
          therapy2 = therapy2,
          c_index1 = c1,
          c_index2 = c2,
          diff = NA_real_,
          p_value = NA_real_,
          n1 = ifelse(!is.null(therapy_results_list[[i]]$qual_results$n), 
                     if(model_name == "Qualitative") therapy_results_list[[i]]$qual_results$n else
                     if(model_name == "Quantitative") therapy_results_list[[i]]$quant_results$n else
                     therapy_results_list[[i]]$ml_results$n, 0),
          n2 = ifelse(!is.null(therapy_results_list[[j]]$qual_results$n),
                     if(model_name == "Qualitative") therapy_results_list[[j]]$qual_results$n else
                     if(model_name == "Quantitative") therapy_results_list[[j]]$quant_results$n else
                     therapy_results_list[[j]]$ml_results$n, 0)
        )
        next
      }
      
      # Bootstrap comparison of C-indices
      # We need to bootstrap the difference in C-indices
      set.seed(123)
      diff_observed <- c1 - c2
      diff_bootstrap <- numeric(0)
      
      # Bootstrap each therapy group separately
      for (b in 1:n_bootstrap) {
        # Bootstrap therapy 1
        boot_idx1 <- sample(1:nrow(data1), size = nrow(data1), replace = TRUE)
        data1_boot <- data1[boot_idx1, ]
        
        # Bootstrap therapy 2
        boot_idx2 <- sample(1:nrow(data2), size = nrow(data2), replace = TRUE)
        data2_boot <- data2[boot_idx2, ]
        
        # Calculate C-index for each
        c1_boot <- NA_real_
        if (nrow(data1_boot) > 0 && sum(data1_boot$death_event_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
          surv_formula1 <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(os_time_landmark, death_event_landmark) ~ ", group_var))
          cox1_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula1, data = data1_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
          if (!is.null(cox1_boot)) {
            c1_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox1_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
          }
        }
        
        c2_boot <- NA_real_
        if (nrow(data2_boot) > 0 && sum(data2_boot$death_event_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
          surv_formula2 <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(os_time_landmark, death_event_landmark) ~ ", group_var))
          cox2_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula2, data = data2_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
          if (!is.null(cox2_boot)) {
            c2_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox2_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
          }
        }
        
        # Only include successful bootstrap samples
        if (!is.na(c1_boot) && !is.na(c2_boot)) {
          diff_bootstrap <- c(diff_bootstrap, c1_boot - c2_boot)
        }
      }
      
      # Calculate p-value only from successful bootstrap samples
      if (length(diff_bootstrap) > 0) {
        p_value <- mean(abs(diff_bootstrap) >= abs(diff_observed), na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        p_value <- NA_real_
      }
      
      comparisons[[paste0(therapy1, " vs ", therapy2)]] <- list(
        therapy1 = therapy1,
        therapy2 = therapy2,
        c_index1 = c1,
        c_index2 = c2,
        diff = diff_observed,
        p_value = p_value,
        n1 = ifelse(!is.null(therapy_results_list[[i]]$qual_results$n), 
                   if(model_name == "Qualitative") therapy_results_list[[i]]$qual_results$n else
                   if(model_name == "Quantitative") therapy_results_list[[i]]$quant_results$n else
                   therapy_results_list[[i]]$ml_results$n, 0),
        n2 = ifelse(!is.null(therapy_results_list[[j]]$qual_results$n),
                   if(model_name == "Qualitative") therapy_results_list[[j]]$qual_results$n else
                   if(model_name == "Quantitative") therapy_results_list[[j]]$quant_results$n else
                   therapy_results_list[[j]]$ml_results$n, 0)
      )
    }
  }
  
  return(comparisons)
}

# Compare each model across therapy types
therapy_comparisons_qual <- compare_model_across_therapy(
  "Qualitative",
  list(sensitivity_neoadjuvant, sensitivity_adjuvant, sensitivity_palliative, sensitivity_no_therapy),
  c("Neoadjuvant", "Adjuvant", "Palliative", "No Systemic Therapy")
)

therapy_comparisons_quant <- compare_model_across_therapy(
  "Quantitative",
  list(sensitivity_neoadjuvant, sensitivity_adjuvant, sensitivity_palliative, sensitivity_no_therapy),
  c("Neoadjuvant", "Adjuvant", "Palliative", "No Systemic Therapy")
)

therapy_comparisons_ml <- compare_model_across_therapy(
  "ML",
  list(sensitivity_neoadjuvant, sensitivity_adjuvant, sensitivity_palliative, sensitivity_no_therapy),
  c("Neoadjuvant", "Adjuvant", "Palliative", "No Systemic Therapy")
)

# Complete sensitivity_no_therapy with pairwise comparisons
sensitivity_no_therapy <- c(sensitivity_no_therapy, list(
  comp_quant_vs_qual = compare_c_indices(
    survival_quantitative_therapy %>% 
      filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE)) %>%
      left_join(survival_qualitative_therapy %>% 
                  filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE)) %>%
                  select(patient_id, qualitative_group), by = "patient_id"),
    "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", 
    "quantitative_group", "qualitative_group"
  ),
  comp_quant_vs_ml = compare_c_indices(
    survival_quantitative_therapy %>% 
      filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE)) %>%
      left_join(survival_ml_therapy %>% 
                  filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE)) %>%
                  select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id"),
    "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", 
    "quantitative_group", "ml_group"
  ),
  comp_qual_vs_ml = compare_c_indices(
    survival_qualitative_therapy %>% 
      filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE)) %>%
      left_join(survival_ml_therapy %>% 
                  filter(coalesce(!has_any_systemic, TRUE)) %>%
                  select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id"),
    "os_time_landmark", "death_event_landmark", 
    "qualitative_group", "ml_group"
  )
))
```

```{r extract_histology, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Extract Histology Information
# ==============================

# Extract histology and primary site for all patients in dat_combined, then filter to common patients
histology_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^histology$|histology.*type", ignore_case = TRUE))]
primary_location_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("primary.*tumor.*location|tumor.*location|primary.*site", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(histology_cols) > 0) {
  # Build select columns conditionally
  select_cols <- c("patient_id", histology_cols[1])
  if (length(primary_location_cols) > 0) {
    select_cols <- c(select_cols, primary_location_cols[1])
  }
  
  patient_histology_all <- dat_combined %>%
    select(all_of(select_cols)) %>%
    mutate(
      histology_raw = as.character(.data[[histology_cols[1]]]),
      histology_clean = str_replace_all(histology_raw, 
                                        regex("urothelial/transitional|transitional/urothelial", ignore_case = TRUE), 
                                        "urothelial"),
      is_urothelial = str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), "urothelial|transitional"),
      primary_site = if(length(primary_location_cols) > 0) {
        as.character(.data[[primary_location_cols[1]]])
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      primary_site_clean = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(primary_site), "bladder") ~ "Bladder",
        str_detect(tolower(primary_site), "renal.*pelvis|pelvis") ~ "Upper Tract",
        str_detect(tolower(primary_site), "ureter") ~ "Upper Tract",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      # Categorize: Urothelial Carcinoma of Bladder vs UTUC or Variant Histology
      is_bladder_urothelial = primary_site_clean == "Bladder" & is_urothelial,
      histology_binary = case_when(
        is_bladder_urothelial ~ "Urothelial Carcinoma of Bladder",
        !is_urothelial | primary_site_clean != "Bladder" ~ "UTUC or Variant Histology",
        TRUE ~ "UTUC or Variant Histology"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, is_urothelial, is_bladder_urothelial, histology_binary)
  
  # Filter to common patients and ensure all are included
  patient_histology <- tibble(patient_id = common_patients_all_models) %>%
    left_join(patient_histology_all, by = "patient_id")
} else {
  patient_histology <- tibble(
    patient_id = common_patients_all_models,
    is_urothelial = NA,
    is_bladder_urothelial = NA,
    histology_binary = NA_character_
  )
}

# Merge histology information with survival data for sensitivity analyses
survival_qualitative_histology <- survival_qualitative %>%
  left_join(patient_histology %>% select(patient_id, is_urothelial, is_bladder_urothelial, histology_binary), by = "patient_id")

survival_quantitative_histology <- survival_quantitative %>%
  left_join(patient_histology %>% select(patient_id, is_urothelial, is_bladder_urothelial, histology_binary), by = "patient_id")

survival_ml_histology <- survival_ml %>%
  left_join(patient_histology %>% select(patient_id, is_urothelial, is_bladder_urothelial, histology_binary), by = "patient_id")
```

```{r display_sensitivity_analysis, echo=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Display Sensitivity Analysis Results
# ==============================

cat("## Sensitivity Analysis: Model Performance by Therapy Type\n\n")
cat("This analysis examines whether C-index and pairwise comparisons differ when stratified by therapy type.\n\n")

# Helper function to format results
format_sensitivity_table <- function(sens_results, therapy_name) {
  tibble(
    `Therapy Type` = therapy_name,
    `N (Qualitative)` = ifelse(!is.null(sens_results$qual_results$n), sens_results$qual_results$n, 0),
    `C-Index Qual (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(sens_results$qual_results$c_index),
      paste0(round(sens_results$qual_results$c_index, 3), " (",
             round(sens_results$qual_results$ci_lower, 3), "-",
             round(sens_results$qual_results$ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A"),
    `N (Quantitative)` = ifelse(!is.null(sens_results$quant_results$n), sens_results$quant_results$n, 0),
    `C-Index Quant (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(sens_results$quant_results$c_index),
      paste0(round(sens_results$quant_results$c_index, 3), " (",
             round(sens_results$quant_results$ci_lower, 3), "-",
             round(sens_results$quant_results$ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A"),
    `N (ML)` = ifelse(!is.null(sens_results$ml_results$n), sens_results$ml_results$n, 0),
    `C-Index ML (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(sens_results$ml_results$c_index),
      paste0(round(sens_results$ml_results$c_index, 3), " (",
             round(sens_results$ml_results$ci_lower, 3), "-",
             round(sens_results$ml_results$ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A")
  )
}

# Create combined table
sensitivity_table <- bind_rows(
  format_sensitivity_table(sensitivity_neoadjuvant, "Neoadjuvant"),
  format_sensitivity_table(sensitivity_adjuvant, "Adjuvant"),
  format_sensitivity_table(sensitivity_palliative, "Palliative"),
  format_sensitivity_table(sensitivity_no_therapy, "No Systemic Therapy")
)

sensitivity_table %>%
  kable(caption = "Table: C-Index by Therapy Type (Sensitivity Analysis)", align = "c") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  add_footnote("C-Index: Harrell's concordance index (higher is better, 0.5 = random, 1.0 = perfect). 95% CI calculated using bootstrap (n=500).", notation = "symbol")

cat("\n### Pairwise Comparisons by Therapy Type\n\n")

# Helper function to format pairwise comparisons
format_pairwise_table <- function(sens_results, therapy_name) {
  tibble(
    `Therapy Type` = therapy_name,
    `Comparison` = c("Quant vs Qual", "Quant vs ML", "Qual vs ML"),
    `Diff C-Index (95% CI)` = c(
      ifelse(!is.na(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_qual$diff_c_index),
        paste0(round(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_qual$diff_c_index, 3), " (",
               round(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_qual$diff_ci_lower, 3), "-",
               round(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_qual$diff_ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A"),
      ifelse(!is.na(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_ml$diff_c_index),
        paste0(round(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_ml$diff_c_index, 3), " (",
               round(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_ml$diff_ci_lower, 3), "-",
               round(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_ml$diff_ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A"),
      ifelse(!is.na(sens_results$comp_qual_vs_ml$diff_c_index),
        paste0(round(sens_results$comp_qual_vs_ml$diff_c_index, 3), " (",
               round(sens_results$comp_qual_vs_ml$diff_ci_lower, 3), "-",
               round(sens_results$comp_qual_vs_ml$diff_ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A")
    ),
    `P-Value` = c(
      ifelse(!is.na(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_qual$p_value),
        ifelse(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_qual$p_value < 0.001, "<0.001",
               round(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_qual$p_value, 4)), "N/A"),
      ifelse(!is.na(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_ml$p_value),
        ifelse(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_ml$p_value < 0.001, "<0.001",
               round(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_ml$p_value, 4)), "N/A"),
      ifelse(!is.na(sens_results$comp_qual_vs_ml$p_value),
        ifelse(sens_results$comp_qual_vs_ml$p_value < 0.001, "<0.001",
               round(sens_results$comp_qual_vs_ml$p_value, 4)), "N/A")
    ),
    `N (Common)` = c(
      ifelse(!is.null(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_qual$n_common), sens_results$comp_quant_vs_qual$n_common, 0),
      ifelse(!is.null(sens_results$comp_quant_vs_ml$n_common), sens_results$comp_quant_vs_ml$n_common, 0),
      ifelse(!is.null(sens_results$comp_qual_vs_ml$n_common), sens_results$comp_qual_vs_ml$n_common, 0)
    )
  )
}

  add_footnote("P-values test the null hypothesis that C-index difference = 0. Calculated using bootstrap (n=500) with two-sided test.", notation = "symbol")

cat("\n### Comparison of Same Model Performance Across Therapy Types\n\n")
cat("This analysis tests whether the same model performs significantly differently across different therapy types.\n\n")

# Helper function to format therapy comparison table
format_therapy_comparison_table <- function(comparisons_list, model_name) {
  if (length(comparisons_list) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  result_list <- map(comparisons_list, function(comp) {
    tibble(
      Model = model_name,
      Comparison = paste0(comp$therapy1, " vs ", comp$therapy2),
      `C-Index 1` = ifelse(!is.na(comp$c_index1), round(comp$c_index1, 3), "N/A"),
      `C-Index 2` = ifelse(!is.na(comp$c_index2), round(comp$c_index2, 3), "N/A"),
      `Difference` = ifelse(!is.na(comp$diff), round(comp$diff, 3), "N/A"),
      `P-Value` = ifelse(!is.na(comp$p_value),
                        ifelse(comp$p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", round(comp$p_value, 4)),
                        "N/A"),
      `N1` = comp$n1,
      `N2` = comp$n2
    )
  })
  
  bind_rows(result_list)
}

therapy_comp_table_quant <- format_therapy_comparison_table(therapy_comparisons_quant, "Quantitative")
therapy_comp_table_ml <- format_therapy_comparison_table(therapy_comparisons_ml, "ML")

# Combine all comparisons

  therapy_comp_table_qual,
  therapy_comp_table_quant,
  therapy_comp_table_ml
)

if (nrow(therapy_across_comparisons) > 0) {
  therapy_across_comparisons %>%
    kable(caption = "Table: Comparison of Same Model Performance Across Therapy Types", align = "c") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    add_footnote("P-values test the null hypothesis that C-index difference = 0 between therapy types for the same model. Calculated using bootstrap (n=500) with two-sided test.", notation = "symbol")
  
  cat("\n**Important Statistical Note: Why Non-Overlapping 95% Confidence Intervals Don't Guarantee p < 0.05**\n\n")
  cat("It is a common misconception that non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for two independent estimates guarantee a statistically significant difference (p < 0.05). However, this is not always true. Here's why:\n\n")
  cat("1. **CIs are for individual estimates, not the difference**: The 95% CIs shown in the heatmap represent the uncertainty around each individual C-index estimate. They are not confidence intervals for the *difference* between two C-indices.\n\n")
  cat("2. **Variance of the difference**: When comparing two independent estimates, the variance of their difference equals the *sum* of their individual variances (not the difference). This means the standard error of the difference can be larger than what might be inferred from the individual CIs.\n\n")
  cat("3. **Different sample sizes**: When comparing groups with different sample sizes (e.g., n=39 vs n=84), the standard errors differ, and the variance of the difference accounts for both. A larger difference in sample sizes can lead to wider confidence intervals for the difference, even when individual CIs don't overlap.\n\n")
  cat("4. **Mathematical relationship**: For two independent estimates with 95% CIs that don't overlap, the p-value for testing their difference is typically < 0.05. However, this relationship breaks down when:\n")
  cat("   - Sample sizes are very different\n")
  cat("   - The standard errors of the two estimates differ substantially\n")
  cat("   - The estimates are not perfectly independent (though in this analysis, therapy groups are independent)\n\n")
  cat("5. **Bootstrap method**: The bootstrap p-values shown in this table directly test the null hypothesis that the difference equals zero, accounting for the joint distribution of both C-indices. This provides a more accurate assessment than simply checking CI overlap.\n\n")
  cat("**Example from this analysis**: The Quantitative model shows C-indices of 0.709 (95% CI: 0.627-0.806) for Palliative therapy and 0.971 (95% CI: 0.947-0.999) for No Systemic Therapy. While these CIs don't overlap, the bootstrap p-value is 0.382, which is not statistically significant. This occurs because:\n")
  cat("   - The sample sizes differ (n=71 vs n=84)\n")
  cat("   - The standard errors of the C-indices differ\n")
  cat("   - The variance of the difference accounts for both sources of uncertainty\n\n")
  cat("**Conclusion**: Always rely on the formal statistical test (p-value) rather than visual inspection of CI overlap when assessing statistical significance.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("Unable to calculate comparisons across therapy types.\n\n")
}
```

```{r create_cindex_visualizations, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Create C-Index Visualizations
# ==============================

# Prepare data for therapy type heatmap
prepare_heatmap_data <- function(sens_results_list, names_list) {
  result_list <- map2(sens_results_list, names_list, function(sens, name) {
    qual_c <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$qual_results) && !is.na(sens$qual_results$c_index), 
                     sens$qual_results$c_index, NA_real_)
    quant_c <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$quant_results) && !is.na(sens$quant_results$c_index), 
                      sens$quant_results$c_index, NA_real_)
    ml_c <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$ml_results) && !is.na(sens$ml_results$c_index), 
                   sens$ml_results$c_index, NA_real_)
    
    qual_n <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$qual_results) && !is.null(sens$qual_results$n), 
                     sens$qual_results$n, 0)
    quant_n <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$quant_results) && !is.null(sens$quant_results$n), 
                      sens$quant_results$n, 0)
    ml_n <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$ml_results) && !is.null(sens$ml_results$n), 
                   sens$ml_results$n, 0)
    
    qual_ci_lower <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$qual_results) && !is.na(sens$qual_results$ci_lower), 
                            sens$qual_results$ci_lower, NA_real_)
    quant_ci_lower <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$quant_results) && !is.na(sens$quant_results$ci_lower), 
                              sens$quant_results$ci_lower, NA_real_)
    ml_ci_lower <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$ml_results) && !is.na(sens$ml_results$ci_lower), 
                          sens$ml_results$ci_lower, NA_real_)
    
    qual_ci_upper <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$qual_results) && !is.na(sens$qual_results$ci_upper), 
                            sens$qual_results$ci_upper, NA_real_)
    quant_ci_upper <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$quant_results) && !is.na(sens$quant_results$ci_upper), 
                              sens$quant_results$ci_upper, NA_real_)
    ml_ci_upper <- ifelse(!is.null(sens$ml_results) && !is.na(sens$ml_results$ci_upper), 
                          sens$ml_results$ci_upper, NA_real_)
    
    tibble(
      Stratum = name,
      `Qualitative` = qual_c,
      `Quantitative` = quant_c,
      `ML` = ml_c,
      `Qualitative_N` = qual_n,
      `Quantitative_N` = quant_n,
      `ML_N` = ml_n,
      `Qualitative_CI_Lower` = qual_ci_lower,
      `Quantitative_CI_Lower` = quant_ci_lower,
      `ML_CI_Lower` = ml_ci_lower,
      `Qualitative_CI_Upper` = qual_ci_upper,
      `Quantitative_CI_Upper` = quant_ci_upper,
      `ML_CI_Upper` = ml_ci_upper
    )
  })
  bind_rows(result_list)
}

# Therapy type data
therapy_heatmap_data <- prepare_heatmap_data(
  list(sensitivity_neoadjuvant, sensitivity_adjuvant, sensitivity_palliative, sensitivity_no_therapy),
  c("Neoadjuvant", "Adjuvant", "Palliative", "No Systemic Therapy")
) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Qualitative`, `Quantitative`, `ML`), 
               names_to = "Model", values_to = "C_Index") %>%
  mutate(
    N = case_when(
      Model == "Qualitative" ~ `Qualitative_N`,
      Model == "Quantitative" ~ `Quantitative_N`,
      Model == "ML" ~ `ML_N`,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    CI_Lower = case_when(
      Model == "Qualitative" ~ `Qualitative_CI_Lower`,
      Model == "Quantitative" ~ `Quantitative_CI_Lower`,
      Model == "ML" ~ `ML_CI_Lower`,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    CI_Upper = case_when(
      Model == "Qualitative" ~ `Qualitative_CI_Upper`,
      Model == "Quantitative" ~ `Quantitative_CI_Upper`,
      Model == "ML" ~ `ML_CI_Upper`,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Label = ifelse(!is.na(C_Index), paste0(round(C_Index, 3), "\n(n=", N, ")"), "N/A")
  ) %>%
  select(Stratum, Model, C_Index, N, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, Label)

# Histology data
histology_heatmap_data <- prepare_heatmap_data(
  list(sensitivity_urothelial, sensitivity_other_histology),
  c("Urothelial Carcinoma of Bladder", "UTUC or Variant Histology")
) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Qualitative`, `Quantitative`, `ML`),

      Model == "Qualitative" ~ `Qualitative_N`,
      Model == "Quantitative" ~ `Quantitative_N`,
      Model == "ML" ~ `ML_N`,

    ),
    CI_Lower = case_when(
      Model == "Qualitative" ~ `Qualitative_CI_Lower`,
      Model == "Quantitative" ~ `Quantitative_CI_Lower`,

    ),

      Model == "Qualitative" ~ `Qualitative_CI_Upper`,

      Model == "ML" ~ `ML_CI_Upper`,

    ),
    Label = ifelse(!is.na(C_Index), paste0(round(C_Index, 3), "\n(n=", N, ")"), "N/A")
  ) %>%
  select(Stratum, Model, C_Index, N, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, Label)

# Create combined data for overall comparison

  therapy_heatmap_data %>% mutate(Stratification = "Therapy Type"),
  histology_heatmap_data %>% mutate(Stratification = "Histology")

  mutate(
    Stratum_Label = ifelse(Stratification == "Histology", Stratum, paste0(Stratification, ": ", Stratum))

# Combined heatmap
heatmap_combined <- ggplot(combined_heatmap_data, aes(x = Model, y = Stratum_Label, fill = C_Index)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), color = "black", size = 2.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027",
    mid = "#ffffbf",
    high = "#1a9850",
    midpoint = 0.65,

    limits = c(0.4, 1.0),
    name = "C-Index"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Stratification, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1, labeller = labeller(Stratification = c("Therapy Type" = "Therapy Type", "Histology" = ""))) +
  labs(
    title = "C-Index Heatmap: Model Performance Across All Stratifications",
    subtitle = "Higher C-index indicates better predictive performance (0.5 = random, 1.0 = perfect)",
    x = "Model",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )
```
